newsitem.title: USA: CSCE raises margins on March "C" coffee futures.
newsitem.headline: CSCE raises margins on March "C" coffee futures.

text.p: Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Echange said Thursday it raised margins on the March "C" coffee contract by $750 to $2,500, effective Jan 16.
The margin on all other coffee contracts will be raised by $250 to $2,000, the exchange said in a statement.

As of Jan 16, CSCE will increase trade margins on all straddle and arbitrage transactions involving the March 1997 contract by $500 to $1,200. Margins on all other straddle and arbitrage transactions of "C" coffee futures will remain $700.
For customers who are not exchange members or members of the trade, margins will be 140 percent above the trade rates. ((--Patricia Avidan, New York Commodities Desk, 212-859-1640))
